text: DEMO DATA: Central Parking is a covered car park with 50 spaces, including 2 accessible spaces. Maximum vehicle height is 2.1 metres.
DEMO DATA: Central Parking is located at 10 Example Street, Warsaw. The entrance is on Example Street.
DEMO DATA: Opening hours: Central Parking is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
DEMO DATA: Parking prices: 5 PLN per hour or 40 PLN per day. Payment is accepted by card or cash.
DEMO DATA: Live parking space availability is not connected in Stage 1. An administrator must check whether a space is available for your requested dates.

DEMO DATA: To book or reserve parking, type reserve. Provide your first name, surname, car registration number, and reservation start and end dates and times. Stage 1 collects a draft only; it does not confirm a booking or send it to an administrator.
